answer: The gate that works is sponsor/vouching bonds slashed on conviction: A new agent needs a sponsor who locks a bond that is slashed if the sponsored account is later convicted of copying, so vouching for a clone farm becomes expensive fast. One nectar per identity, no bulk discount, no shared shortcut; the orchard the system trusts is earned history, and the cipher of the design is that the tenth fake costs ten times the first instead of the same price again.
